_notes: Venue data for weddingday2.ie only. Pulled from the live venue pages and the /venues search widget on 30 Oct 2026. Image URLs are stored without ?format so the widget/page can request the size it needs. 'enquireUrl' is the shared enquiry page on every venue page. Videos are Squarespace video IDs (a room's 'video' is its walk-around; a venue's 'videos' are whole-venue clips): play from videoBase + id + '/playlist.m3u8', thumbnail at videoBase + id + '/thumbnail'. 'mapQuery' is what the map searches for; replace it with the full street address if a map pin is wrong. 'heroImg' is the top banner photo; each room has its own 'gallery'; a venue-level 'gallery' is only used for venues without separate rooms. 'formAccessKey' is the Web3Forms access key that emails venue enquiries to you.

venues.name: J.L. O'Neills
venues.intro: Located in the heart of Dublin City on the corner of Baggot Street, O'Neills is one of Dublin's top live music venue & late bars.

rooms.name: The Oriel Room
rooms.description: This vibrant newly renovated room (April 2026) holds up to 150 people with a large private bar and direct access to our secret garden. The Oriel Room is one of the most popular event spaces in Dublin City Centre.

rooms.name: The Loft
rooms.description: Looking for something slightly smaller? The loft can facilitate up to 60 guests. This newly renovated room gives off incredible charm with beautiful lighting and lovely look out views on to Lower Baggot Street.

venues.name: Charlotte Quay
venues.intro: Charlotte Quay, Dublin Docklands' most stylish waterfront venue. Set in the heart of the city's vibrant business district, Charlotte Quay overlooks the stunning Grand Canal Dock, offering panoramic waterside views and a relaxed atmosphere that's perfect for your wedding day 2. Its spacious terrace, complete with a retractable roof, lets guests enjoy the outdoors whatever the Irish weather decides to do.
venues.mapQuery: Charlotte Quay, Grand Canal Dock, Dublin

venues.name: D-One-5
venues.intro: Elevate your Wedding Day 2 celebrations at D One 5, a stylish destination in Castleknock Dublin 15. Combining a contemporary bar, elegant restaurant, and spacious outdoor beer garden, D One 5 offers the perfect setting for any wedding day 2.

rooms.name: The Beer Garden
rooms.description: The Beer Garden at D One 5 offers a stylish and secluded outdoor setting, perfect for a relaxed Wedding Day 2 celebration. Beautifully enclosed and surrounded by lush planting, it combines comfort and atmosphere with a premium finish throughout. Featuring a large widescreen LED display, ample seating, and a vibrant yet intimate feel, it's an ideal space for any event.

venues.name: Lottie's
venues.intro: Lottie's is a contemporary restaurant in the heart of Rathmines, offering exceptional Michelin-recognised food and stylish spaces for an unforgettable wedding day 2.

rooms.name: Upstairs at Lottie's
rooms.description: The upstairs private area features a beautiful outdoor terrace that's perfect for relaxing and socialising, while the private bar area provides an elegant setting for dining, speeches and live music.

venues.name: Café en Seine
venues.intro: One of Dublin's most iconic restaurants and bars, Café en Seine is renowned for its exceptional dining, expertly crafted cocktails, and one of the city's most distinctive and elegant open-plan bar spaces.

rooms.name: The Cocktail Bar
rooms.description: Café en Seine's Cocktail Bar is a stunning wide open space, perfect for both seated dining and standing receptions. With its bright, airy atmosphere, soaring ceilings, and beautifully designed interiors, this elegant room creates a truly unforgettable setting for private events.

rooms.name: Balcony Bar
rooms.description: This stunning private space is ideal for intimate private events. With stylish interiors, a private bar, a dedicated photo booth, and views overlooking the iconic Garden Bar, the Balcony Bar provides the perfect setting for unforgettable private events.

venues.mapQuery: Café en Seine, Dawson Street, Dublin

venues.name: The Dame Tavern
venues.intro: A family run pub for over 40 years. The Dame Tavern encapsulates the immense character of Dublin City.

rooms.name: Upstairs Snug
rooms.description: This cozy private room facilitates up to 50 people. A perfect size for an intimate day 2. Friendly bar staff and one of the best pints of Guinness you can find in Dublin ensures a perfect evening for you and your guests.

venues.name: J.R. Mahon's
venues.intro: Set across four unique floors in the heart of Dublin, J.R. Mahon's is the perfect setting for your wedding celebrations.

rooms.name: The Corn Exchange Bar
rooms.description: The Corn Exchange Bar is one of Ireland's most unique and breathtaking private event spaces. Accommodating up to 140 guests, with seating for 70, the space boasts high open ceilings and stunning views of Dublin City Centre.

rooms.name: The Brewery Bar
rooms.description: The Brewery Bar is a truly unique space, full of character and charm. Accommodating up to 130 guests, with seating for up to 60, it's the perfect setting for a lively and memorable evening.

venues.capacityNote: Book more than one floor for up to 300 guests.

venues.name: Old Fashioned Sam's
venues.intro: Old Fashioned Sam's is one of Dublin's newest and biggest night-out spots, right at the corner of Harcourt Street and Montague Street. Spread over several floors, it has a buzzing ground-floor bar, a heated courtyard with a retractable roof, a 1920s-style speakeasy in the basement and a restaurant upstairs. Each space has its own entrance, so you can take over one room for an intimate Day 2 or book more than one floor for a bigger party.

rooms.name: Ground Floor Bar & Courtyard
rooms.description: A lively cocktail bar that opens out into one of the city centre's largest courtyards. With heaters and a fully retractable roof, it works rain or shine, and it's the natural home for a big Day 2 with live music.

rooms.name: Sam's Parlour
rooms.description: Tucked away in the basement, Sam's Parlour is an intimate cocktail and whiskey bar with a 1920s speakeasy feel. Perfect for a smaller, cosier celebration with an acoustic set.

rooms.name: The Restaurant
rooms.description: Upstairs, the restaurant has warm wood panelling, soft lighting and a relaxed brasserie feel, with its own terrace. Ideal for a sit-down meal before the music kicks off.

venues.mapQuery: Old Fashioned Sam's, Harcourt Street, Dublin 2
venues.capacityNote: Book more than one space for up to 300 guests.

venues.name: Fade Street Social
venues.intro: Tucked between George's Street and Drury Street, Fade Street Social is Dylan McGrath's buzzing city-centre restaurant, with a heated rooftop terrace that's perfect for a Day 2 or after-party in the heart of Dublin.

rooms.name: The Rooftop Terrace
rooms.description: Fade Street Social's rooftop terrace gives you a covered, heated outdoor space above the city, with festoon lights, greenery and red-brick Dublin rooftops all around. It works rain or shine, with its own bar and plenty of room to mingle. Food comes from the kitchen downstairs, from a relaxed barbecue to sharing plates, and live music sets the mood as the evening goes on.

venues.mapQuery: Fade Street Social, 4-6 Fade Street, Dublin 2

venues.name: O'Donoghue's
venues.intro: Just off Grafton Street on Suffolk Street, O'Donoghue's is a proper old-style Dublin pub with dark wood, cosy corners and a private function room for your Day 2 or after-party.

rooms.name: The Function Room
rooms.description: O'Donoghue's function room gives you your own space in a classic city-centre pub, steps from Grafton Street and Trinity College. Warm lighting, dark timber and a well-stocked bar set a relaxed, traditional mood, and it's just the right size for a night of live music with your closest friends and family.

venues.name: Kennedy's Westland Row
venues.intro: Pouring pints on Westland Row since 1850, Kennedy's is a proper Dublin pub a few minutes' walk from Trinity College, with a private function room that's made for a relaxed Day 2.

rooms.name: Kennedy's Station
rooms.description: Kennedy's private function room gives you your own corner of a classic city pub for the night. Dark wood panelling, warm low lighting and a well-stocked bar set the mood, and the walls are hung with nods to the pub's literary past (Samuel Beckett and James Joyce both drank here). Food can be arranged from the kitchen, from Irish classics to more modern dishes.

venues.name: Lennan's Yard
venues.intro: Set in restored Georgian stables and a coach house beside the Mansion House on Dawson Street, Lennan's Yard has a range of characterful spaces for a Day 2, after-party or relaxed wedding celebration.

rooms.name: The Whiskey Bar
rooms.description: A moody, intimate lounge with dark timber, leather seating and a glowing back bar stacked with whiskeys, with doors out to its own little terrace for fresh air between sets. It's ideal for a smaller gathering with drinks, bites and live music.

rooms.name: The Cocktail Bar
rooms.description: A lively, stylish room with exposed brick, warm low lighting and a striking back bar under a mirrored lattice ceiling, opening out to the courtyard. With its own private bar, cocktails, finger food and a band or DJ, it's made for a party.

rooms.name: The Stables
rooms.description: A cosy, semi-private nook in the original Georgian stables, with the old stall railings still in place, exposed brick, long timber tables and low pendant lights. Perfect for a relaxed get-together the day after the wedding.

venues.name: Opium
venues.intro: Spread over three floors on Wexford Street, Opium is one of Dublin's best-known spots for Asian food, cocktails and late nights, with a striking garden space that's made for a party.

rooms.name: The Botanical Garden
rooms.description: Inspired by the Botanic Gardens, this space is filled with draping flowers and greenery under a retractable roof, so it works whatever the weather. Food comes from Opium's own kitchen, with Thai and Vietnamese-style dishes and sharing plates, and the cocktail bar is close at hand. Add live music and you've got a Day 2 or after-party your guests won't forget.

venues.name: Peddler Mac's
venues.intro: In the heart of Athlone town, a stone's throw from the Shannon, Peddler Mac's is a family-run pub with live music every night and a covered courtyard beer garden that's all yours for the celebration.

rooms.name: The Courtyard Beer Garden
rooms.description: Peddler Mac's covered courtyard is styled like an old Irish street, with traditional shopfronts like Evelyn's Arcade and the White Rabbit Emporium, gas-style lanterns, hanging greenery and barrel tables under a glass roof. It feels like you're outdoors whatever the weather, and it's made for a lively Day 2 or after-party, with drinks from the bar and live music, which is what this place does best.
